name: The Morning Tide
source:
A short visual novel with many different routes to take . You play as a nonbinary guide who finds a strange creature washed ashore.  You introduce it to the area and your friends/co-workers. 

[from [url=https://pod-ruben.itch.io/the-morning-tide]itch.io[/url]]
